'''Zentine Dynamics''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturer that built the [[Ministry-class orbital shuttle|''Ministry''-class orbital shuttle]] at its [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] at<ref name="KOTORCG" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Foerost system/Legends|Foerost system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Byss">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050414planet2|series=Byss and the Deep Core|text=Part 2: Empress Teta}}</ref> [[Foerost/Legends|Foerost]] following the end of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] in [[3996 BBY]]. The [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Old Sith Wars|wars]] fought in the [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] following the conflict.<ref name="KOTORCG" />

By [[3643 BBY]], over three [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] later,<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Corporate Espionage" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> during the then-ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the company was developing plans for a new [[Zentine Dynamics prototype shuttle|prototype shuttle]]. Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], a [[Unidentified slicer (Zentine Dynamics)|slicer]] hiding on the astronomical object [[Verroth]] [[Thief/Legends|stole]] the plans for the prototype shuttle.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Corporate Espionage}}</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Subsequently, an individual affiliated with one of the two opposing sides of the conflict dispatched a companion to Verroth to retrieve the shuttle plans from the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]].<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Zentine Dynamics was first mentioned in the [[2008]] [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''.<ref name="KOTORCG" />
